title: Biltong, egg and avo salad
summary: A low-carb lunch with a South African twist.
steps: Lower the eggs into a pot of boiling water and cook for 8 minutes, then move them to cold water for a few minutes and peel.
Wash and tear the lettuce, cut the tomato into wedges and slice the avo.
Slice the biltong thinly across the grain.
Toss the lettuce and tomato with the olive oil and a squeeze of lemon, then top with the halved eggs, avo and biltong.
